name: garna_attacker_dies_draws
notes: FIXED 2026-11-17 (wave E1: IS_ATTACKING reads LastKnown.attacking, and a bare Conditional judges it on 'it'), passes against both drafts; write Garna's record from draft_conditional.py (one ability, as printed), then move this pack to tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/. Was: KNOWN BUG, fails today (M5 mapper, 2026-11-17; FDN Garna, Bloodfist of Keld is needs-atom for it). Run it against either draft beside it: `cardtool.py runpack FDN <this pack> --card "Garna, Bloodfist of Keld" --draft <draft>`. Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was attacking. Otherwise, Garna deals 1 damage to each opponent.' Seat 0's Bear attacks alone (Garna stays home) and Opp Giant (4/4) blocks and kills it: the Bear died attacking, so seat 0 draws a card and seat 1 takes nothing. Today both drafts deal 1 damage to seat 1 and draw nothing: IS_ATTACKING reads the live attack record, which the dead Bear has left (Executor._remove_from_combat), never its LastKnown.attacking; draft_conditional.py's bare Conditional also judges IS_ATTACKING on Garna, the source (executor._conditional_subject).
